description: Defines the AlarmApiCallResult class, which encapsulates the result of an alarm API call, including status flags, alarm details, and propagation info.

classes.name: AlarmApiCallResult
classes.description: Represents the outcome of an alarm API call, including success status, alarm data, and propagation details.

methods.name: AlarmApiCallResult
methods.description: Constructor initializing all fields of the result, with a builder pattern.

methods.name: isSeverityChanged
methods.description: Checks if the severity of the alarm has changed compared to the old alarm.

methods.name: isAcknowledged
methods.description: Checks if the acknowledgment status of the alarm has changed.

methods.name: getOldSeverity
methods.description: Returns the old severity if it has changed, otherwise null.

methods.name: isPropagationChanged
methods.description: Determines if propagation-related properties have changed or if the alarm was just created.
